name: 2S Li-ion protection board (BMS)
description: Protects a 2-cell Li-ion/LiPo pack against over-charge, over-discharge and short circuit.
notes: Model: B+ and P+ are joined; the BMS switches the negative side (B- to P-) with MOSFETs. Here B- and P- are modelled as one ground for simplicity.
Current rating (rating_a) depends on the board: 3 A, 5 A, 8 A and 10 A versions look alike. Read the listing and set rating_a.
Wire the cells first: B- to cell 1 -, BM to the middle, B+ to cell 2 +. Wrong order destroys the board.
Cut-off voltages are typically 4.25-4.3 V per cell (charge) and 2.5-3.0 V per cell (discharge).

pins.name: B+
pins.label: B+
pins.note: To the + of cell 2 (top of the stack).

pins.name: BM
pins.label: BM
pins.note: Balance / midpoint: between cell 1 + and cell 2 -.

pins.name: B-
pins.label: B-
pins.note: To the - of cell 1 (bottom of the stack).

pins.name: P-
pins.label: P-
pins.note: Pack output - (load and charger). Switched by the BMS MOSFETs.
